about: What the desk believes about markets, stated without naming an instrument, with every piece of evidence for and against. A principle climbs the ladder only on evidence registered in advance (docs/prereg). The progress report (ops/progress.py) counts these; the desk engineer updates this file when a registered result lands, never otherwise.

ladder.found: positive on the discovery instruments, real history
ladder.replicated: also positive on held-out instruments it was never fitted to
ladder.forward: survives real point-in-time quotes going forward (the cost check passed)
ladder.proven: made money in the paper account at registered size for 3 months or more
ladder.rejected: tested as registered and failed; kept, because knowing what doesn't work is knowledge

principles.statement: Option sellers are paid more than the move they insure on the last night before expiry.

evidence.result: 20-delta strangle, k=1: +Rs 649/lot (about +2.6 bps of spot), t 2.87, 398 expiries 2019-26
+9.08 bps/trade, t 2.81, 212 expiries 2021-26, 36% of premium kept
+11.34 bps, t 2.40, 26 expiries (too few to be a candidate), 42% kept
+2.98 bps, t 0.59, 67 expiries: positive but weak
weekly mean across the 5 instruments: +8.87 bps, t 4.46 over 286 weeks, positive in both parts; 5 of 5 instruments positive

pending: forward on real quotes: expiry_seller_v1 (NIFTY, BANKNIFTY), v3 (FINNIFTY, MIDCPNIFTY, SENSEX)

principles.statement: The short-premium edge is eaten by a few shock days; far-out-of-the-money wings bought as insurance turn an unlimited loss into a known one for a fraction of the premium.

evidence.result: 0.05-delta wings keep 60% of the strangle's mean (t 2.66) and cut the worst trade from -Rs 50,684 to -Rs 20,891
best wing t 1.99 against a 2.0 bar: the tail falls, the mean falls below significance
the insured 0.05-wing condor: +5.07 bps, t 3.28 over 286 weeks, 5 of 5 instruments positive; no single instrument strong enough alone (FINNIFTY t 2.07 but negative in its last third)

principles.statement: How much the market will move is forecastable even when where it moves is not: intraday seasonality plus a heterogeneous-horizon (HAR) model beats a plain recent-volatility estimate.
principles.note: passed a locked out-of-sample test in time (2019-26, fitted on 2010-18) on both indices it was built on; that is not yet replication on instruments it never saw

evidence.result: QLIKE 20-35% better than the desk's forecaster at 30m-to-close horizons; DM t +4.6 to +12.7 on the lock period
